## Checklist

- [ ] A test that failed before the change and passes after it (or a note why there can't be one)
- [ ] Commits are in English and start with `[feat]`, `[fix]`, … (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Hkhyyy/qurry/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] User-facing changes are in `docs/` and the same page in `docs/ko`
- [ ] New GUI or TUI UI has a Storybook story
- [ ] No screenshots, generated files (`src/wasm/pkg`, `storybook-static`) or local config committed
